newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Zim Israel navigation chief to resign.
newsitem.headline: Zim Israel navigation chief to resign.

text.p: The president of Zim Israel Navigation Co Ltd Matty Morgenstern has informed his company's board of directors that he plans to resign, according to a letter obtained by Reuters.
The letter of resignation comes amid press reports that Morgenstern was forced out by Shoul Eisenberg who owns a controlling interest in Zim, one of the world's 10 largest shipping companies.
Israeli finance sources said Eisenberg and his son Ervin were planning a major reorganisation at Zim to return the company to profitability.
Zim reported a $6.3 million loss in the third quarter of 1996.
The sources speculated that Shaol Eisenberg and his son are expected to take a more active role in the company's management.
Morgenstern has headed Zim for the past 12 years.
